positions.rationale: Source AR «حي محيرس، المبرز» (governing) / EN «Muhairis district, Al-Mubarraz». Phrasing follows the binding sibling wafrah-winter.place «Район Эль-Вафра, к югу от Эль-Хуфуфа»: capitalised generic «Район» + name in the nominative (termbase Эль-Вафра: «с родовым словом район не склоняется»), then comma; the second member here is the bare city name, not «к югу от …», because the source has no direction — exactly the «X, Эль-Хуфуф» shape of siblings bisht / qaisariyah-nights / kafu-nights / dates-festival. Names: «Эль-Мубарраз» verbatim from the verified termbase entry (Al-Mubarraz, rod м, ru.wikipedia + saudipedia); «Мухайрис» verbatim from the approved page title title_ru «Дворец Мухайрис» (src/content/attractions/muhairis.md) and the termbase entries «дворец Мухайрис» and «Каср-Мухайрис» (stem by the Arabic-Russian practical transcription: ح→х, fatha+ya→ай, س→с). No article: Arabic «محيرس» is written without «ال», so «Эль-Мухайрис» would invent one (the article in «Эль-Вафра» comes from «الوفرة»); likewise «Каср-» is not used since the district is not the palace. Pattern «район + name» also matches termbase Mubarraz districts (район Эль-Фейсал, район Эш-Шуруфия). Nothing added: no street, building number, «Айн-Мансур», direction or description. Plain text, one line, U+0020 only.

alternatives.rejected: «город» is not in the source and no sibling place adds a generic before the city (all «…, Эль-Хуфуф»).
invents an article absent from Arabic «محيرس»; drops the source's «district / حي».
«квартал» departs from the sibling's «Район» and the termbase district entries (район Эль-Фейсал / Эш-Шуруфия); termbase reserves «квартал» for the historic Эль-Фридж quarter.
breaks the comma-list shape used by every sibling place field.

notes: «Мухайрис» as a district name has no own termbase entry; its form is taken from the palace entries/approved title (same Arabic spelling محيرس), which are status pending (pattern-based, no Russian attestation). With «район» the name stays undeclined. Arabic and English agree on substance; no source discrepancy to raise.
